_comment: Machine-checkable calendar of moving legal/regulatory/platform dates (P47; platform dates added P55). Mirrors the 'Known moving dates to watch' prose in docs/FRESHNESS.md as dated JSON. Platform entries use the platform name as the jurisdiction. Drift invariant 43 (advisory) surfaces any date whose effective (or phase_2) has passed while verified_after < effective, so a took-effect-but-still-pending date can never sit silently. STAGED / diagnostic only: applying a correction is a separate human step recorded in volatile-corrections.2026-07-14.json. verified_after is the last date the corresponding registry source was confirmed AFTER the rule took effect (null = not yet re-verified since).

dates.description: New York synthetic-performer advertising disclosure law (S8420-A): in effect 2026-06-09. Verified 2026-09-04 against the chaptered text on the NY Senate site: Chapter 617, signed 2025-12-11, effective on the 180th day (2026-06-09); GBL 396-b conspicuous-disclosure duty where the advertiser has actual knowledge; $1,000 first / $5,000 subsequent violation.

California AI Transparency Act (SB 942, Ch. 291, amended by AB 853, Ch. 674): operative 2026-08-02; phase-2 obligations effective 2027-01-01 cover large online platforms AND generative-AI hosting platforms; a phase-3 capture-device manufacturer set is effective 2028-01-01 (not a separate field here). Covered provider: >1,000,000 monthly visitors/users, publicly accessible in California. Verified 2026-09-04 against the codified BPC div. 8 ch. 25 text on leginfo; no further amending bill found.

EU AI Act Article 50 (transparency / AIGC labelling obligations): applies 2026-08-02 (Art. 113). Verified 2026-09-04: the Commission's Article 50 transparency guidelines and the 2026-06-10 Code of Practice on marking and labelling AI-generated content are in force (digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu); EUR-Lex itself is fetch-blocked from cloud egress, so the registry source uses the verbatim explorer text as its fallback. Seeded as registry source eu-ai-act-article-50 on 2026-09-04.
Florida 9th Edition (2026) Building Code adoption window closes 2026-12-31.
North Carolina 2024 Building Code expected effective circa 2027 (approximate; confirm the exact adoption date closer to the window).

Homebrew disables Gatekeeper-failing casks from 2026-09-01 (formula bottles like ffmpeg/whisper-cpp are unaffected). Drives the docs/SETUP_MAC.md dated-context note. Verified 2026-09-04 against the release post: 'We will disable all Homebrew/homebrew-cask casks that fail Gatekeeper checks in September 2026' (month precision; formula bottles unaffected).

macOS 27 (expected fall 2026) drops Intel support; macOS 26 Tahoe is the last Intel release, and Rosetta narrows to certain older games starting macOS 28. Drives the Intel copy in docs/SETUP_MAC.md and the transcribe/arch-aware messaging.

The OpenAI Assistants API was shut down on 2026-08-26 (deprecated 2025-08-26; the deprecations page states it was 'officially sunset ... and is no longer available', verified 2026-09-04). API guidance targets the Responses API and the Conversations API. Drives implementation/gpt/api/README.md phrasing.
